description: SYNTHETIC example match policy. Thresholds and feature weights are DECLARED here and loaded by entity_match.py / cross_ledger.py; nothing is hardcoded in the scripts. Bands: score >= high -> auto; low <= score < high -> candidate; score < low -> non-match. Forcing flags (order_variant, suffix_conflict) always demote to candidate. exact_norm = 1.0 saturates the score to 1.0 (see references/match_policy.md).
